```{r}
#| echo: false
library(tidyverse)
```
```{r}
food_beverages <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2026/2026-05-05/food_beverages.csv')

ggplot(food_beverages, aes(x = Year, y = Sugar)) +
    geom_point() + 
    labs(
        x = "Year",
        y = "Sugar levels"
    )
```
